instruction: Please add a new blank slide at the end of this baseball presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding one new blank slide at the end of the presentation. Original has 8 slides, so after adding one slide, total should be 9. The getter returns slide count, last slide index, and whether the last slide is blank. The metric verifies: (1) total count is 9, (2) last slide index is 8, and (3) last slide is blank with no text content.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all three instruction requirements: (1) total slide count = 9, (2) last slide is at the end (index 8), (3) last slide is blank
Getter logic is correct: retrieves file, counts slides, checks last slide position and blank status
Metric logic is correct: verifies all three aspects with appropriate checks
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts right state (count, position, blank status) and metric compares correctly
Postconfig appropriately saves the file before verification

Minor limitation: 'blank' detection only checks text content (via shape.text), not other content types like images, charts, or videos. A slide with only an image would incorrectly pass as 'blank'. However, for typical LibreOffice Impress usage where 'blank slide' means 'no text', this is acceptable.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider enhancing blank detection to check for all shape types (images, charts, videos, etc.), not just text shapes. Current implementation: 'if hasattr(shape, "text") and shape.text.strip()' only counts text. A more robust check would count all non-placeholder shapes.
Optional improvement: Check slide.shapes_count or iterate all shapes regardless of type to ensure truly blank (only default layout elements)
validation.fix_notes: Updated getter to return dict with total_count, last_slide_index, and last_slide_is_blank. Updated metric to verify all three aspects: count=9, last slide at position 8 (0-based index), and last slide is blank (no text content). This addresses all LLM judge concerns about incomplete verification.
